rejected: NVDA are not funds; single stocks enter only through a screen, never a hand-picked list

universe.fund_list: symbols: funds or ETFs, or set: sector_etfs | core_etfs | benchmarks. {"type": "fund_list", "set": "sector_etfs"}
universe.screen: single stocks in the backfill universe; min_history_days, min_price. Carries a survivorship caveat
universe.french: Ken French research portfolios, no survivorship bias, daily from 1963 on the factor calendar. set: industry_12 | industry_49 | size_deciles | momentum_deciles. {"type": "french", "set": "industry_12"}. Benchmark defaults to FF.MKT; a pass is research only, never paper

grammar.signals: metric_id from features, window like 63d, 6m or 1y (or {param}d), transform: raw, rank, inverse_rank, zscore, inverse
grammar.entry: {"top_n": 3 or "param:top_n", "min_signal": 0} (min_signal applies to the first signal's raw value), or "top 3 by rank"
grammar.exit: "rebalance", or {"hold_rank": 5} to keep a holding while it ranks in the top 5
grammar.rebalance: weekly, monthly or quarterly; signals at the close, trades at the next open
grammar.params: {"top_n": {"min": 2, "max": 5, "default": 3}} or a list of allowed values; grid values must sit inside
grammar.costs: set by the lab: 5 bps funds and French portfolios, 15 bps stocks, 25 bps thin stocks
grammar.factor_check: automatic: alpha after the six French factors on the walk-forward record; alpha t of 2 or more passes

rule.optional: mix (funds, defaults to the plan), deposit_monthly (default 1000), start_value (default 10000), account, date_range
rule.notes: margin needs rate_pct as one number; every rule runs against deposits split pro rata with no selling; grid cap 12
